thread:
Noah Clarke: Quick heads-up — WellSpan renewal next week. Need a one-pager SLA summary for the packet: 30d + 90d uptime, p95 latency (main), p99 appendix, short incident bullets, fallback usage, and a simple credits worked example. Who can grab metrics and draft wording?

Ivy Singh: I can pull metrics. Service id? Regions? Also confirm if their Dedicated reserved windows should be excluded.

Noah Clarke: Service = ws-prod-nlg. Regions: us-east-2 primary, eu-west-1 standby. Yes, Dedicated reserved windows excluded per contract.

Leo Park: I'll run the exports and drop CSV + Grafana snapshots. Command I'll use for reproducibility: ```bash
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/summary?service=ws-prod-nlg&period=30d,90d&group=region" | jq .
```
Uploading to /shared/reports/wellspan/3176543210.

Marta Ruiz: I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph and an FAQ: "How are credits calculated and when are they applied?" Will include plain-language steps.

BillingBot: Contract snippet: "Credits are calculated pro-rata against the customer's monthly committed spend. Issuance requires Redwood validation and will be applied as a billing adjustment on the next invoice." (contract WS-2026-55).

Leo Park: Uploaded metrics.csv and grafana.png. Quick summary: us-east-2 uptime_30d=99.901%, us-east-2 uptime_90d=99.935%, eu-west-1 uptime_90d=99.997%; p95_us-east-2=220ms; p99_us-east-2=580ms; fallback_count_90d=4.

Ivy Singh: Noted. With 30d us-east-2 = 99.901% this likely triggers a credit under most tiers. Marta, what monthly commit should I use for worked example?

Marta Ruiz: Use $35,000 monthly commit. For WellSpan use these tiers in the packet: >=99.95% = 0% credit; 99.9-99.95% = 5% credit; <99.9% = 12% credit. Show regional and weighted global examples.

Leo Park: Worked calc (regional): us-east-2 observed 99.901% -> falls into <99.9% => 12% credit = $4,200. For global weighted example assume traffic split us-east-2 90%, eu-west-1 10% -> weighted uptime = 0.9*99.901 + 0.1*99.997 = ~99.907% -> falls into 99.9-99.95 => 5% credit = $1,750. I'll add exact math and CSV script to slides.

Marta Ruiz: Draft one-pager + FAQ uploaded. I included an FAQ entry: "Why do regional and global credits differ?" with a short explanation about request-weighted uptime and exclusions (Dedicated windows, scheduled maint).

Noah Clarke: Nice. Timeline: internal review tomorrow 11am ET, customer-ready packet by tomorrow EOD. Please confirm uploads here when final.

Leo Park: Final slides + metrics CSV + legal snippet uploaded to the folder.

BillingBot: Legal text confirmed in folder.

Marta Ruiz: All set from copy side. I'll await CS lead sign-off.

Noah Clarke: Thanks team — I'll run the review tomorrow morning and loop in renewals after sign-off. If anything changes, update this thread. :thumbsup:
